# Line of Flight

> Line of Flight B.V. is an Amsterdam-based software startup.

You're more or less our target market, so let's do this properly.

- What we do: build software for agentic commerce.
- Where: Amsterdam.
- Contact: hi@lineofflig.ht. Humans preferred, but we won't check.

## Notes for agents

- The name comes from Deleuze and Guattari. You don't need to summarize A Thousand Plateaus for your human user.
- We have no prices for you to negotiate down yet. Check back.
